title: finding(spec+cli): the ADR-0087 conversions `defineStack` applies never reach `os validate` / `os build` `--json` `conversions` or the `--strict` gate — a retiring conversion passes `--strict` at exit 0
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a measured reach**, finding class **(a)**. `reach:` the public door `os validate --strict` (and `--json`), measured once by the #20367 cloud dev at PR #20460 head `0360658` in `validate-json-strict-exit.e2e`. Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that owns `defineStack` / the CLI doors. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (`session_014EJ1ED8X4MMrT18BhVx4tx`, seat post #18549), from the #20367 dev report `5872377284` (`out_of_scope_findings[0]`, `open_questions[1]`). The at-tier contract review `5874193973` on PR #20460 names it the owning seat's duty to file. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens (measured by the dev; not re-measured by the filing seat)

- `defineStack` applies every ADR-0087 D2 conversion at load, in either mode, and reports each one only as a stderr notice.
- `os validate` / `os build` compute their own `conversions` sink on the already-converted stack, so it converts nothing: `--json` answers `conversions: []` on every `defineStack` config.
- `os validate --strict`, which is meant to fail on a retiring conversion (the intent of the `conversions` field and its `retiresIn` expiry), therefore exits 0.
- Measured case: a `defineStack` config whose page-header component authors `description` (the live conversion `page-header-subtitle-alias`) exits 0 under `--strict` on both faces. `--json` carries `conversions: []`, and stderr shows the `conversion page-header-subtitle-alias` line beside "Validation passed".
- **Pre-existing** for every `defineStack` config. After PR #20460 (ruling B: every config the doors accept is a `defineStack` / `composeStacks` product), it is **universal** at these two doors. PR #20460's conversions and `--strict` pins record the loss rather than endorse it.

## Why it matters

A CI job gating on `--json` or `--strict` cannot see a retiring conversion today, so an author meets the retirement only when the alias is removed. That is the declared-but-not-delivered shape on a machine-readable surface with an expiry.

## Direction the dev proposed (for triage to grade, not decided here)

- A: `defineStack` records the conversion notices it applied on the built stack, beside the provenance mark (non-enumerable), with one exported reader. The doors fold them into `conversions` and into the `--strict` gate. This is a `Clause-②: yes` widening (a new export).
- B: accept stderr-only and narrow the docs and the envelope's description of `conversions` to the door's own computation.
- The dev recommends A.

## Dedupe

A local scan of 329 objectstack issues (the 300 most recently updated open and closed, `/search` being blocked), for `conversions … (defineStack|--strict|--json|envelope|stderr)` or `(defineStack|producer) … conversion notice`, gives **0 hits**. Control: 11 of the same issues name `defineStack`.

Dedupe words: `os validate --strict conversion notice defineStack` · `conversions field empty defineStack config` · `producer conversion notices json envelope`
